title: Care Management
description: Care Management documentation for System Admin.
overview: This guide covers care management workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Follow Up Query
subtasks.purpose: Identify patients who require a follow-up call based on the most recent vital readings and demographic filters.

steps.title: Open Follow-Up Query
steps.description: Click Care Mgmt in the sidebar, then choose Follow Up.

steps.title: Filter Follow-Up Criteria
steps.description: Filter by Last Name, First Name, Practice, Provider, Caregiver and Status.

steps.title: Run or Reset Search
steps.description: Click Query to run the search, or Reset to clear the filters.

steps.title: Review Activity Columns
steps.description: Review results — the # Readings and Time columns highlight patients with recent activity that may warrant intervention.

steps.title: Log a Follow-Up Action
steps.description: Use the Action column on each row to log a follow-up call, note or task. Notes Follow Up Query surfaces patients based on latest-reading thresholds and activity — combine with Patient Mgmt reports for full billing context. Selecting a Caregiver filter narrows to that caregiver’s panel, which is useful for daily huddles. Task 6.8 — Calendar
